title: Optimize Your Brain Health with Lifestyle Medicine
description:
What if nearly half of dementia cases could be prevented? Growing scientific evidence says it's possible—and it starts with the choices we make every day. Join Dr. Melissa Sundermann, a double board-certified Lifestyle Medicine physician known as Doctor Outdoors, for an engaging look at the science behind lifelong brain health. From nutrition and movement to sleep, stress management, social connection, and time outdoors, discover how everyday habits shape cognitive performance and long-term wellbeing. You'll leave with practical, research-backed strategies—and a personalized roadmap for protecting your brain, your most valuable asset.
